input: Prep a professional development plan for next year

gold.taskTitle: Build My Professional Development Plan for Next Year
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured, actionable professional development plan covering the next year to guide career growth and skill-building.

questions.title: What is your current role and industry?
questions.description: Understanding your current position and field ensures the plan is relevant and grounded in your actual work context.

questions.title: What specific career goal drives this plan?
questions.description: Identifying the single primary outcome you want — promotion, career switch, skill mastery — shapes every other decision in the plan.

questions.title: Which skills do you most urgently need to build?
questions.description: Pinpointing one to three priority skill gaps helps focus the plan on what will move the needle fastest for you.

questions.title: What learning formats work best for you?
questions.description: Knowing whether you prefer courses, books, mentorship, conferences, or on-the-job projects determines what activities go into the plan.

questions.title: How much time per week can you realistically dedicate?
questions.description: A realistic time budget prevents an overloaded plan and ensures milestones are actually achievable alongside your existing workload.

questions.title: Do you have a budget for courses, events, or tools?
questions.description: Knowing your financial ceiling — whether self-funded or employer-sponsored — determines which resources and activities are on the table.

questions.title: Does your employer need to review or approve this plan?
questions.description: If a manager or HR team is involved, the plan may need specific formatting, alignment with company goals, or formal sign-off steps.
